{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a cleaned version of the data by replacing -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute the change in biomarker (final - baseline)
# Only compute for non-missing baseline values
trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Stratify by severity and compute mean biomarker change within each severity stratum
mean_change_by_arm_severity = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['biomarker_change'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute response rate by arm within each severity stratum
response_rate_by_arm_severity = trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the difference in biomarker change within each severity stratum
change_diff_by_severity = mean_change_by_arm_severity.loc['treatment'] - mean_change_by_arm_severity.loc['control']

# Compute the difference in response rates within each severity stratum
response_diff_by_severity = response_rate_by_arm_severity.loc['treatment'] - response_rate_by_arm_severity.loc['control']

print('Mean biomarker change by arm and severity:\n', mean_change_by_arm_severity)
print('\nResponse rate by arm and severity:\n', response_rate_by_arm_severity)
print('\nDifference in biomarker change (treatment - control) by severity:\n', change_diff_by_severity)
print('\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by severity:\n', response_diff_by_severity)"}
